mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_reports ( id, mold_id, report_title, report_period_start, report_period_end, total_usage_count, total_production_time, fault_count, repair_cost_total, maintenance_completed_count, maintenance_planned_count, maintenance_rate, health_score, status, pdf_file_path, generated_by, generated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{moldId}, #{reportTitle}, #{reportPeriodStart, typeHandler=com.zjb.mjgl.typehandler.LocalDateTypeHandler}, #{reportPeriodEnd, typeHandler=com.zjb.mjgl.typehandler.LocalDateTypeHandler}, #{totalUsageCount}, #{totalProductionTime}, #{faultCount}, #{repairCostTotal}, #{maintenanceCompletedCount}, #{maintenancePlannedCount}, #{maintenanceRate}, #{healthScore}, #{status}, #{pdfFilePath}, #{generatedBy}, #{generatedAt, typeHandler=com.zjb.mjgl.typehandler.LocalDateTimeTypeHandler} )
